name: message-commits
description: Use when creating or reviewing a commit message from staged changes — analyzes the git diff and proposes a Conventional Commits title. Triggers on requests like "write the commit message for this", "what message should I use for this diff?", "generate a commit message for the staged changes", "review this commit message", "turn 'fixed the login' into a conventional commit", "summarize what I staged into a one-line commit subject", or "what type and scope should I use here?". Do NOT use to review code CORRECTNESS, bugs, security, or test coverage of the diff — that is team-code-review. Produces a single type(scope): description line (e.g. feat(auth): add JWT token-based user authentication, fix(payment): resolve bug in payment processing, docs(readme): update installation instructions), ready for git commit.
